title: zazzle-csharp-indexer live index component diagram
description: One RootIndex per work tree, fed by git listings and a platform change source, writing file records to the store and analysing new content through the engine.

components.name: Live index
components.responsibility: Keeps the work trees' file records current.

components.name: Root index (RootIndex.cs)
components.responsibility: Initial and periodic reconcile, debounced handling of change events, the barrier before queries, the generation counter and change log.

components.name: FSEvents source (FsEventsSource.cs)
components.responsibility: File-level FSEvents stream on macOS; replays history from a stored event id.

components.name: FileSystemWatcher source (FswSource.cs)
components.responsibility: Recursive .NET watcher on every other system; no replay.

components.name: Engine and store
components.responsibility: Shared blob tables, blob analysis on first sight of new content, and the SQLite store of roots and file records.

components.name: git command-line tool
components.responsibility: ls-files -co --exclude-standard lists the files; check-ignore --stdin filters unknown event paths.

components.name: macOS CoreServices FSEvents API
components.responsibility: Delivers file-system events with persistent event ids.

relationships.description: Changed and NeedsFullScan events; LastEventId persisted for replay.
Listing on every reconcile; ignore check for event paths it does not know.
Engine.GetOrAddBlob for changed content; Store for root id, event id, last full scan and file records.
